name: oasis-build-package
prerequisites: Installed project producer, declared target profiles, compatible pinned toolchain, writable isolated output and cache ownership. Missing platform capability is a reported prerequisite, not a fabricated command.

scenarios.expected: Reuse its exact bytes after revalidation; no duplicate production.

scenarios.trigger: Version matches but producer input or one mirrored asset differs
scenarios.expected: Reject reuse and identify the actual mismatch.

scenarios.trigger: Build process exited but expected companion artifacts are missing
scenarios.expected: Record incomplete build; do not claim package readiness.
